caption: A single uncut medium shot behind a stainless steel kitchen counter. The same middle-aged chef faces the camera and begins a slow turn toward the stove. He has a shaved head, thick black eyebrows, a close gray beard, deep-set brown eyes, and a focused expression. He wears a crisp white chef jacket with black buttons, a cobalt blue apron, and a red thermometer clipped to the left chest pocket. A white plate with three basil leaves sits in front of him. Smooth continuous motion, no scene cut, warm restaurant kitchen lighting.
